generator_cmd: sh cobol_gen.sh   # real GnuCOBOL 3.2 (apt-get download gnucobol3 libcob4-dev libcob4t64; dpkg-deb -x tools/gnucobol/root; cobc drives system gcc), blob via python3 zlib.crc32+struct, gcc C decoy
